content.title: 强调句 It is/was … that/who … 速查
content.intro: 想突出句子里的某一部分(常为对比或加强语气),就把它放进框架 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who…。判断口诀:去掉 It is/was … that,句子仍然完整通顺,就是强调句。

rows: It is the volunteers who clean the beach.(用 who 或 that)
It is carbon dioxide that plants need.(一律 that)
It is clean energy that we should choose.(用 that)
It was in 1958 that the gas was first measured.(仍用 that,不用 when/where/why)
It was not until midnight that the team arrived.(直到……才……)

specialRules.rule: 无论强调时间、地点还是原因,连接词都用 that,不用 when/where/why——这是强调句与定语从句最大的区别
specialRules.mark: It was here that… √ / It was here where… ✗

specialRules.rule: 强调的是人,可用 who 或 that;强调物/事只能用 that
specialRules.mark: It is Janine who/that started it.

specialRules.rule: It was not until + 时间/事件 + that + 主句(主句不倒装)
specialRules.mark: It was not until he left that I knew.

specialRules.rule: 一般疑问句强调:Is/Was it + 被强调部分 + that/who…?
specialRules.mark: Was it CO₂ that the plants needed?

why: 强调句只是给句子加了一层 It is/was … that 的'外壳',句子本身的成分一个不少;正因为被强调的部分已经被'抽'到 that 前面,that 后面的从句往往会缺一个成分,而连接词只起'连接'作用,所以固定用 that(人用 who),不随被强调成分变化。
gaokaoPoints: that vs when/where/why:看是不是 It is/was … that 强调句,是就用 that;高考语法填空、单选高频。
强调句 vs 定语从句:去掉 It is/was … that 后句子完整=强调句;去掉后不完整、需要先行词=定语从句。
It was not until … that … 的固定搭配与主句不倒装。

examVsReal.exam: It is health that matters most.(考试/书面强调)
examVsReal.real: Health is what matters most. / Health really matters.
examVsReal.note: 口语里更常用 what-分裂句或加 really、do/does/did 来强调

examVsReal.exam: It was John who broke the window.(考试)
examVsReal.note: 口语常靠重读和语气强调,不一定动用整个 It is…that 框架
